subject.title: Create codex / claude plugins for each crawler

question: Should per-crawler Codex/Claude plugin bundles be owned by crawlkit, downstream apps, or ClawHub packages, and is any shared crawlkit API needed first?
rationale: Source inspection can show the current boundary and missing implementation, but it cannot choose marketplace, package ownership, or how much assistant-specific surface belongs in this shared Go library.

options.title: Keep bundles outside crawlkit
options.body: Use crawlkit's existing control metadata where possible, publish per-crawler bundles from downstream or ClawHub packages, and revisit crawlkit only for a proven shared API gap.

options.title: Add provider-neutral scaffolding
options.body: Define a small crawlkit-owned metadata or manifest helper while leaving crawler-specific workflows and prompts in downstream packages.

options.title: Sponsor core bundle work
options.body: Accept crawlkit as the home for a first-party bundle suite and require a concrete cross-crawler design before implementation.

recommendation.title: Keep bundles outside crawlkit
recommendation.body: Use crawlkit's existing control metadata where possible, publish per-crawler bundles from downstream or ClawHub packages, and revisit crawlkit only for a proven shared API gap.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest current history match for the shared scheduler/control surface where any crawlkit-side scaffolding would likely land.
